metric: abs_error <= atol + rtol*abs(reference), plus NRMSE where declared

gemm.reason: one BF16 spacing with 1e-3 near-zero allowance, FP32 accumulation

rmsnorm.reason: full FP32 reduction and model epsilon, one BF16 spacing

rope.reason: FP32 phase and explicit BF16 multiply/add cast points

swiglu.reason: two BF16 pointwise outputs, SiLU then product

attention.reason: BF16 inputs and output; different legal FP32 reduction and probability cast paths

decoder_layer.reason: predeclared engineering tolerance for composed BF16 operators; not an analytical error bound

model_logits.reason: predeclared composed BF16 tolerance; does not waive token or cache identity checks
